entry_state: Paid-or-due consideration counts credited advances once, and the billing identity reconciles balances independently of the payment schedule. Unfinished production uses different material and conversion denominators; joint products and byproducts retain their own allocation bases. Supplier financing separates inventory cost from interest. The uncertain-tax case has introduced full-information examination and measurement choice, with its numerical branches continuing next.
exit_state: The uncertain-tax branches keep current and deferred amounts consistent under the stated fictional law. Only explicitly compatible operating cases are combined. Inspection replacement removes the old component before capitalizing the new inspection. The lease-reduction case now distinguishes surrendered rights from price changes and has removed ROU 20 and liability 25 for a gain 5; remeasurement of the surviving arrangement continues next.
findings: The tax example's equal total tax across branches follows its particular ultimate-deduction law; the text does not generalize that equality or infer actual law from the example.
The combined operating slice explicitly selects five compatible EU cases, uses independent lots and excludes unrelated Australian and tax cases.
Inspection replacement preserves original cost allocation and does not invent a zero disposal when old cost is unknown.
The lease example states homogeneous-rights assumptions before using a surrender fraction. Its remaining measurement is pending. No new confirmed defect.
